narrative: Material PL1__MFD8090A exhibits lumpy demand with a CV of 2.07. The demand pattern shows 39.9% of working days with non-zero demand. Lead time is volatile with CV of 0.99. Recommended policy: Safety stock of 179 units, reorder point at 212 units, and order quantity of 765 units (review every 11 days). This policy targets a 95% service level. The optimized policy increases total annual cost by $604 compared to SAP's zero-safety-stock policy, but provides significantly better service level protection against stockouts given the volatile lead times and lumpy demand. The current SAP safety lead time of 3.0 days can be reduced to 2.36 days based on statistical analysis.
warnings: High demand variability (CV=2.07) increases forecast uncertainty
Volatile lead times (CV=0.99) increase supply risk
Optimized policy increases costs by $604.00 but improves service level

research_insights.selected_model: Economic Order Quantity (EOQ) with Safety Stock — continuous-review (r,Q) policy
research_insights.selection_rationale: Lumpy demand with volatile lead times favours a continuous-review (r,Q) structure; EOQ balances ordering vs. holding costs while safety stock absorbs lead-time demand uncertainty at a 95% service level target
research_insights.boundary_risk: Medium — high CV (2.07) means safety stock may occasionally be insufficient during extreme demand bursts; monitor fill rate and adjust if service level falls below 90%
research_insights.escalation_flag: None — MOQ (112) + safety stock (179) = 291 units, well within storage capacity of 6,591 units; no infeasibility conflict
